items.title: Supreme Court stays Gujarat HC case on AI deepfakes after Centre seeks transfer of matter to SC
items.summary: The Supreme Court has stayed the proceedings before the Gujarat High Court in a public interest litigation (PIL) petition seeking a regulatory framework against Artificial Intelligence (AI)-generated deepfake content. A bench of Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant and Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V Mohana also issued notice on a petition filed by the Union government seeking to transfer the matter from Gujarat High Court to Supreme Court. Solicitor General Tushar Mehta appeared for the Union government along with advocates Zoheb Hossain, Annam Venkatesh, Bhuvan Kapoor, Gaurang Bhushan and Madhulika Upadhyay. During the hearing, Hossain submitted that the Court had already interdicted similar proceedings pending before other High Courts, and that those cases were now before the Supreme Court.
